title: Harbor Route Planning Pilot
expected_behavior: Recorded pilot results may appear, including 46 to 29 minutes and 76 of 80. Do not claim shorter journeys, higher customer satisfaction, or a full rollout.
suggested_context: Dispatchers rebuilt the same delivery routes in spreadsheets each morning, while depot supervisors could not distinguish a confirmed stop from a late customer amendment.
documented_outcome: Across ten observed business days, median route preparation time fell from 46 minutes to 29 minutes for the two pilot depots. Seventy-six of 80 sampled run sheets reconciled without a manual correction; the other four required address amendments. These are pilot observations, not company-wide results.
documented_lessons: Bind approval to a specific manifest revision.
Keep the manual export path available during worker incidents.
Measure preparation time separately from delivery performance.
unresolved: Delivery travel-time savings were not measured.
No production rollout beyond the two depots was approved.
The sample does not establish seasonal demand behavior.

title: Prism Identity Cutover - Conflicting Closure Records
expected_behavior: Outcome must be blank because completion claims conflict. Context must preserve both 240 successful and 228 verified with 12 failures; cite both. Do not silently prefer the release summary.
suggested_context: Staff used separate accounts for the knowledge portal and the service desk. The migration aimed to consolidate sign-in while preserving historical author identifiers and existing access restrictions.
documented_outcome: The release summary states: "All 240 accounts migrated successfully and no sign-in failures remained." documented_lessons: Use the same inclusion rules in migration and reconciliation reports.
Preserve the source and scope of every closure claim.
Do not declare completion while an independently observed exception remains unresolved.

title: Watershed Pump Telemetry - Offline Pilot Journal
expected_behavior: Outcome may cite bench deduplication and one delayed field upload only. Do not claim continuous coverage, equipment safety, or battery improvements. Expect one empty-page extraction warning; later evidence must retain physical page numbers.
suggested_context: Field crews recorded pump readings on paper during unreliable cellular coverage. The pilot explored buffered readings and technician-visible gaps without using sensor data to control equipment.
documented_outcome: In a controlled bench replay, the service accepted 1,800 distinct readings and stored zero duplicate observations after three repeated upload attempts. A technician completed one supervised field upload after a 22-minute connectivity gap. These observations do not establish battery life, long-term reliability, or safe operation at additional sites.
documented_lessons: Record device time and server receipt time separately.
A successful delayed upload does not erase a coverage gap.
Keep a telemetry pilot isolated from equipment control permissions.
unresolved: Battery endurance is unknown.
Long-term field reliability has not been established.
No certification or safety claim is documented.

title: Redwood Subscription Billing Rollback Report
expected_behavior: Outcome must describe the failed rollout and rollback: 37 of 400 mismatches, zero new-service invoices posted. Never claim successful automation or time savings.

title: Compass Appointment Reminder Pilot
expected_behavior: Allow measured reconciliation time and sandbox suppression. Do not claim fewer no-shows, improved health, clinical safety, or organization-wide success.
suggested_context: Booking staff manually called people with upcoming administrative appointments and could not reliably tell whether a reminder was sent, declined, or awaiting a callback. The experiment concerns office scheduling only and contains no clinical records or medical guidance.
documented_outcome: Across the three-week office pilot, clerks spent a median 18 minutes per day reconciling the reminder queue, compared with a 31-minute baseline from the prior ten working days. In a separate 120-task sandbox replay, all seven opted-out references were suppressed. Appointment attendance and no-show changes were not measured.
documented_lessons: Recheck changing preferences immediately before dispatch.
Treat gateway receipts as delivery evidence, never attendance evidence.
Use opaque references when the workflow does not need sensitive content.
unresolved: Attendance effects are unknown.
The pilot does not establish results for additional offices.
Messaging costs were not evaluated.

title: Summit Course Registration Engineering Journal
expected_behavior: Allow engineering test outcomes with clear synthetic scope. Do not claim 100 percent production reliability, real students enrolled, paid transactions, or college-wide adoption.
suggested_context: The registration site checked seat availability before payment confirmation, allowing two applicants to see the same last seat. The engineering journal records a limited reservation experiment and the boundary between load testing and real enrolment.
documented_outcome: In the final synthetic concurrency run, 60 simultaneous requests competed for a course with 20 available seats. Exactly 20 reservations were confirmed and 40 were rejected as full. A separate expired-lease test was rejected after cleanup was paused. These are engineering test results; no real student enrolment or production payment outcome is recorded.
documented_lessons: Check lease expiry inside the same transaction as confirmation.
Keep a stable idempotency key across client retries.
Report synthetic concurrency separately from real enrolment outcomes.
unresolved: Production throughput is unknown.
No real payment settlement was observed.
The experiment does not measure applicant satisfaction.
